verification_policy: Each record is independently sourced from the structured research corpus and remains partially_verified until reconciled against the canonical in-game acquisition/drop tables.
audit_note: Negative Ultimate Finish claims were removed where the research records did not carry explicit evidence establishing that an Ultimate Finish is not required. Unresolved cases remain null.

records.name: Eraser Bomb
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 163 "Broly the Invader"; 40% Ultimate Finish bonus slot.
records.skill_description: Guided heavy Ki projectile that can be accelerated and steered after launch; with an Awoken Skill active it gains a large explosion.
records.mechanics_notes: Re-input speeds the projectile; stick input bends its trajectory. Awoken-active casts gain the large explosion rider.
records.pve_notes: Useful for ranged pressure and tracking against moving targets; transformation-active casts provide the stronger damage mode.
records.pvp_notes: Steering and acceleration improve neutral pressure, while the Awoken condition rewards transformation-focused builds.

records.name: Spirit Pulse
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 151 "Even Further Beyond"; 50% Ultimate Finish bonus slot.
records.skill_description: Fast single-hit spirit pulse from a forward fist thrust. Ultra Instinct also incorporates the move into its charged-blast kit.
records.mechanics_notes: Ultra Instinct active changes charged Ki Blast inputs: short hold uses Soaring Fist and long hold uses Spirit Pulse.
records.pve_notes: Fast startup and recovery make it useful as combo punctuation and quick ranged damage.
records.pvp_notes: Low-commitment poke and pressure option; UI users already receive its functionality through the Awoken kit.

records.name: Gigantic Explosion
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 164 "Where Is Goku?!"; 40% Ultimate Finish slot.
records.skill_description: Transformation-only 360-degree Ki explosion centered on the user; can also be fired while damaged by spending 400 Stamina.
records.mechanics_notes: Requires an Awoken Skill to be active. The 400-Stamina damaged-state use functions as a combo escape/reversal.
records.pve_notes: Strong against clustered melee enemies and particularly effective when surrounding targets are already close.
records.pvp_notes: Niche but powerful reversal option when transformed; high Ki and Stamina costs demand careful resource management.

records.name: Surging Spirit
records.unlock_method: Built into Ultra Instinct; not independently purchased.
records.skill_description: Ultra Instinct's built-in rapid Ki charge, available while the form is active rather than as a normal equippable charge skill.
records.mechanics_notes: Replaces the normal charge behavior inside Ultra Instinct; research source measures roughly five seconds from empty to full Ki.
records.pve_notes: Supports sustained Ultra Instinct play by shortening the vulnerable recharge window.
records.pvp_notes: Its strategic value is primarily resource recovery inside the Ultra Instinct state; a separate charge skill generally duplicates its role.

records.name: Sword of Hope
records.unlock_method: TP Medal Shop limited-time rotation; 300 TP Medals.
records.skill_description: Ki-sword stance that replaces the user's moveset with multiple sword attacks while continuously draining Ki.
records.mechanics_notes: Four primary sword inputs include Triple Slash, Flying Stab, Spin Slash, and the Upward Slash & Sheathe finisher. The stance ends when Ki is exhausted, the finisher is used, or it is manually canceled.
records.pve_notes: Very strong after a guaranteed opening such as a stamina break; useful for extended melee damage and finishing pressure.
records.pvp_notes: Resource-draining stance is best used during safe advantage windows; opponents can exploit the Ki drain by disengaging or waiting it out.

records.name: DUAL Remote Serious Bomb
records.unlock_method: Reach 80% Total Completion in the Extra Story (Infinite History).
records.skill_description: Partnered DUAL version of Remote Serious Bomb that synchronizes the Serious Bomb setup and detonation between two casters.
records.mechanics_notes: Designed as a co-op DUAL skill; the synchronized cinematic changes the behavior from the solo Remote Serious Bomb and does not preserve its solo transformation-sealing interaction.
records.pve_notes: Primarily a co-op completion reward and synchronized damage option rather than a universal solo loadout staple.
records.pvp_notes: Not applicable to standard solo PvP use; its DUAL mechanics are designed around partner play.
